name: Setup Wizard art loads the 3D helicopter only when drawn
step: Check that opening the Setup Wizard does not load lib/heli3d.lua
rationale:
The Setup Wizard loads app/setup_wizard_art.lua when it opens. lib/heli3d.lua, about
35 kB of source, is drawn only on the orientation check of the Sensors step, a screen the
wizard does not open on. Loaded with the art module, it sat on the Lua heap from the first
frame, and opening the wizard stopped Lua with "Lua has used too much RAM" in the Ethos
simulator.

The harness loads the art module with a counting stand-in for lib/heli3d.lua and pins that
loading it, and the wire style, load nothing, that the first solid service and draw load it
once, and that later calls do not load it again. It then runs the same checks against a
copy that loads lib/heli3d.lua at the top and requires that copy to fail.
